title: An orchestrator stop or deadlock clears an admitted Engram-retained orchestrator prompt from the queue without abandoning its pending dispatch, so the final handoff can still deliver it
outcome: Clearing an orchestrator's queued prompts on a stop or deadlock never leaves an admitted, Engram-retained head deliverable. Either the admitted retained head is preserved, as the public Stop variant does, or its pending dispatch is abandoned, so every change of the queue head moves a field the final handoff guard checks.
acceptance: An orchestrator stop or deadlock clears an admitted Engram-retained orchestrator prompt from the queue without abandoning its pending dispatch, so the final handoff can still deliver it is done
